aggregation: equal scenarios within family, then equal families
interpretation: Normalized area under in-force accuracy across update intervals; equal multiplicative ranges have equal weight. The 0.5–8 s domain spans update rates four times faster and slower than the 2 s recording cadence, with equal log weight on either side. This is a controlled evaluation domain, not an empirical deployment distribution.
selection: The AUC aggregation rule was adopted after inspecting the recorded passes; no recording was repeated or excluded.
